audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes named Shen's Q as 'Vorpal Blade' (an ability Shen does not have) and gave no cooldown anchors.
audit.why: Shen's Q is Twilight Assault (8/7.25/6.5/5.75/5s). Shadow Dash is 18/16/14/12/10s and Stand United is 200/180/160s; Yi's Alpha Strike is 20/19.5/19/18.5/18s and Highlander 85s.
audit.corrected: Spikes rewritten to Twilight Assault, the Meditate cancel at 3, the Stand United all-in at 6, and the Highlander/true-damage flip at two items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three decisive interactions never appeared: Meditate is a channel, Alpha Strike goes untargetable, and Wuju Style deals true damage.
audit.why: Shadow Dash's taunt cancels Meditate outright (channel flag). Alpha Strike's untargetable window eats a timed commit. Wuju Style's true damage means armour is the wrong stack against him.
audit.corrected: Added the Meditate cancel to level 3, the untargetable warning to level 6, the armour-does-not-work line to levels 4-5, and Grievous Wounds to the late game.

edits.before: Through 4-5 your sustained Q shred and shield beat his item-less DPS, and at 6 Stand United plus the taunt make your all-ins decisive — a taunted Yi with your jungler nearby is a dead Yi. By his first item it becomes skill-decided as his DPS catches up, so lean on E timing to swing trades.
edits.after: Through 4-5 your Q shred and shield beat his item-less DPS, and at 6 Stand United plus taunt make all-ins decisive — a taunted Yi with your jungler nearby is a dead Yi. Do not burn Shadow Dash while Alpha Strike is up: he blinks out untargetable and it is down 14s at rank 3.

edits.before: At two-plus items his shred and Highlander resets out-duel your tank sustain, so change jobs: you are now the anti-Yi peel bot. Taunt him the instant he enters a fight, shield the carry he jumps on with R, and let your team burst him inside the lockdown. Never offer him the solo duel.
edits.after: At two-plus items Wuju Style's true damage and Highlander resets out-duel you, so change jobs: you are the anti-Yi peel bot. Armour will not save the carry — taunt him the instant he lands, shield with a 160-second R, and burst him inside the lockdown. Never offer the solo duel.
